description: A bearded man in a dark blue robe with a belt stands in a crowded medieval street of half-timbered houses, handing coins from his hand to a huddled woman in a shawl and a crowd of ragged people. An open wooden chest at his feet spills gold coins onto the cobbles, and a small child with bare feet reaches up. A stone church tower with a spire rises in the hazy background. A small green mark sits in the bottom-right corner.
